propositions: Every rebar ticket write triggers a 486-500 ms O(n) store walk to check if enrichment queue entries are soaked, despite a declared 20 ms budget (25x overrun).
The gate's cost is linear in ticket count because pending_enrichment calls reduce_ticket on every directory, which scans each ticket's events three times (~24,000 metadata syscalls per write).
The budget-breach warning fires on 100% of writes on stores >150 tickets, making it noise and invisible when genuinely soaked entries exist.
Under concurrent writes, the gate contends with itself on filesystem metadata (vnode cache saturation), causing write latency to spike 3-6x on stores with 8-16 concurrent agents.

The fix introduces an O(1) marker file under .rebar that proves the queue is quiet until a specific instant, delegating to a full scan only when necessary, and self-healing via TTL invalidation and append-time marker clearing.
